name: Wikidata
tagline: Free, collaborative knowledge graph of structured data
description: Wikidata is a free, open, collaborative knowledge base that acts as central storage for structured data used by Wikimedia projects and third-party applications. Its public APIs (MediaWiki Action API, Wikibase REST API, and SPARQL endpoint) let developers query entities, properties, and linked data without a paid plan.

auth.details: Public read access needs no key. Write operations use OAuth or a bot password via the MediaWiki Action API; User-Agent identifying the client is strongly recommended.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free for public read access; no paid tiers. Subject to rate limits and fair-use policy.

rate_limits: Identity-based per-minute limits (new in 2026): unidentified 10 req/min; compliant User-Agent-only or newer authenticated users 200/min; established authenticated users 2,000/min (caveats apply; bots/WMCS may be exempt). Limit concurrent requests to ≤3. Prefer dumps/SPARQL for heavy use.
use_cases: look up a Wikidata entity by Q-ID and get labels/descriptions
resolve a Wikipedia title to a Wikidata item ID
run a SPARQL query for structured facts across entities
fetch property values (claims) for an item such as birth date or coordinates
search entities by text for autocomplete or entity linking
